content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Bakersfield

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires either a four-year degree plus three years of project-management experience, or a high school diploma plus five years of experience. Review PMI's full eligibility criteria to ensure you meet educational and professional prerequisites before enrolling in Granite PM Academy's bootcamp.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual PMP bootcamp, delivered by active certified practitioners. Attend instructor-led sessions online at your own pace within the program window. This formal education satisfies PMI's mandatory contact-hour requirement and covers the Project Management Body of Knowledge (PMBOK) framework.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After completing bootcamp coursework, submit your PMP application directly to PMI through their online portal. Verify your project-management experience hours, pay the examination fee, and allow time for PMI to review and approve your eligibility before scheduling your exam.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Pass the PMP Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources—including practice tests, study guides, and instructor support—to strengthen your readiness. Schedule your computerized exam through Pearson VUE and sit for the 180-question test, which assesses your mastery of project-management principles and real-world scenarios.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: Your PMP remains valid for three years. During each renewal cycle, earn professional development units (PDUs) through training, certifications, or project-management activities. Renew your credential with PMI before expiration to continue demonstrating your commitment to the profession across Bakersfield's project-driven sectors.
